taste.name: Serif for Reading, Sans and Mono for Tools
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a product that is a document people read and run code in, and a page that has to show both.
taste.decision: Chose a serif for prose (Source Serif 4, 17/25.5px, 584.5px measure) with Inter for interface and mono for code over one sans family everywhere.
taste.reason: Long explanatory paragraphs read as writing rather than as UI, and the type change tells the visitor which parts are narrative and which are the tool.
evidence: Source Serif 4 x35, Inter x842, Spline Sans Mono x1346

taste.name: Saturation Reserved for Data
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a marketing page for a data-visualization tool.
taste.decision: Chose a gray-blue interface on #F9FAFB/#FFFFFF with one solid blue CTA over a saturated brand palette across the page.
taste.reason: If the page chrome is colorful, the charts have to compete with it. Here the sunburst, maps and gradient thumbnails carry the color.
evidence: surfaces lab(98.26 -0.25 -0.71) 59.9% and #FFFFFF 34.1% of background area
purple, green and orange-red only in chart thumbnails and hero cards
syntax colors #005CC5 / #E36209 / #6F42C1 appear only inside the editor mock

taste.name: Flat, Bordered, No Shadows
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a page full of screenshots and thumbnails that all need an edge.
taste.decision: Chose 1px light borders, 4-6px radii and dark/light bands over drop shadows.
taste.reason: Shadows under dozens of thumbnails add gray haze to the charts. Hairlines keep the edges without changing the colors next to them.
evidence: dark navy hero, light body, near-black footer

taste.name: Two-Register Headline
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a new positioning word ("agentic") to add to an existing tagline.
taste.decision: Chose a 30px w400 lead line with the new word dimmed, followed by a 72px w700 payoff line, over one uniform headline.
taste.reason: The visitor reads the old, familiar phrase first, then the large claim, and the dimmed word marks what changed.
evidence: 72px x1 and 30px x2 in the size distribution, weights 400 and 700
"agentic" in gray (~#6B7280, approx) among white words on the dark hero
